title: Mountain Trail Scout
hook: Good scouts learn the clue and leave the mountain free.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: friendly 3D mountain-trail storybook, simple path signs and alpine scenery, warm daylight, clear foreground objects

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a supervised child scout documenting mountain clues without collecting natural objects or approaching wildlife
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: repeat notice-mark-leave as the ethical memory rule
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: steady 4/4 hiking pulse with field-note pauses
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written field evidence; gear gets use context, hazards get turn-back language, wildlife stays distant
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: field-note cue -> recall beat -> target -> sketch/point gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. small echo responses after targets, with acoustic walking pulse
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: small echo responses after targets, with acoustic walking pulse
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Turn Mountain Trail Scout into evidence-based route reading: trail surface, landmark, weather residue, safe equipment and distant wildlife become field notes, while the song repeatedly rewards leaving things where they are.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child scout records rather than collects; recurring verbs are notice, sketch, mark, compare, leave, check and turn back.
semanticArc: finish by leaving every natural clue undisturbed
forbiddenGenericLanguage: find the mountain clues with me
